public.summary: Read an invoice, add up the lines yourself, and flag it when the printed total is wrong.
public.goal: Extract a Lumen invoice into {"line_items":[{"description","amount"}], "stated_total": n, "computed_total": n, "total_matches": true|false}. Copy stated_total exactly as printed on the invoice. Compute computed_total yourself from the line items. Amounts are numbers, not strings.
public.exampleInput:
Lumen Pro (5 seats) — 12,500
Lumen Analytics add-on — 3,000
Onboarding support — 2,000
Total: 17,500
gradedOn: Output is JSON with line items, stated total, computed total and a match flag
The computed total really is the sum of the line items
The stated total is copied as printed, even when it's wrong
Discounts and credits keep their minus sign
